posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 9 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lateral surface of the lower posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch align horizontally, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct white marking is visible on the anterior surface of the carpal joint (knee) of the visible forelimb.
